title: Import TASKS.md into real bd issues
description: bd.exe was blocked by Smart App Control; once unblocked, migrated the full TASKS.md backlog into bd issues (ch-1 through ch-54).

title: Compare A's and B's independently-converged call-to-sound mappings
description: Once ch-23a logs both units' full call-per-label history (currently only Unit A's): do A and B converge on the *same* mapping, or just two independently-stable ones? That's what grounding would concretely mean here. Needs Unit B upgraded from a passive Listener to a full second ChuffAgent.

title: Babbling warm-up phase in sim/run_demo.py
description: Play random repertoire calls with no external trigger before any real sounds arrive, to test whether it changes how cleanly the repertoire later specialises (motivated by 2024 zebra finch babbling-opens-sensory-phase finding). Not trivial: ChuffAgent.respond() already lazily caches self-reference the first time a call is used, so this needs a real design decision (self-directed reinforcement), not a one-line add.

title: Recency-weighted eviction policy for EmbeddingStore vs. FIFO
description: eviction="fifo"|"recency" (default unchanged), compared in sim/memory_eviction_experiment.py (chuff-sim-memory). Recency wins on every metric at every capacity/churn ratio tried, margin shrinks under severe churn. See shared/research_backlog.md Theme 2.2.

title: Learnable call duration/bandwidth in Repertoire
description: Currently only *which* fixed call is chosen varies. Needed before the compression-vs-redundancy-under-noise question (Theme 3.1) is even testable. More invasive than the others - extends the eval-graded Repertoire contract.

title: Acoustic Adaptation Hypothesis: frequency-dependent channel attenuation
description: world.py gains a real channel model (Butterworth low-pass + distance attenuation); two_unit_demo.py --cutoff/--sweep-seeds confirms it (avg reinforced-call freq 1903Hz no-cutoff vs 1483Hz at 900Hz cutoff, 15 seeds). Exposed and fixed two real bugs: a one-pole filter was too gentle, and Repertoire.frequencies used to be sorted, biasing the untrained tie-break. See shared/research_backlog.md Theme 1.2.

title: Add a second eval/tasks/ task
description: Once the first one has been run against a real model. Candidates: the dream loop (ch-14/33), or the novelty->mood state machine (ch-13/33).

title: Wire eval/harness/agents/gemini_agent.py to a real Gemini run
description: uv add google-genai, set GEMINI_API_KEY. Confirm the automl-style loop in eval/harness/loop.py actually improves a real model's attempts round over round, not just the null/reference smoke tests.

title: Implement mood.py state machine and dream.py
Output safety guardrails (audio_safety.py)
description: NaN/Inf sanitising, duration cap, soft-knee limiter + hard peak ceiling (config.SAFE_*). Every speaker-bound sample in comms.py and sim/ routes through it; chuff-sim demonstrates it clamping a deliberately pathological signal before running any rounds.

title: Implement audio.py (real MFCC) and memory.py (EmbeddingStore) for real
description: librosa MFCC dropping coefficient 0; EmbeddingStore backed by sklearn NearestNeighbors, cosine distance. Proven end-to-end against real synthesised audio in sim/ (uv run chuff-sim). Still needs: a real-microphone test, and mood.py/dream.py (ch-33) to actually drive mood state.

title: MVP proven without hardware: mic RMS loudness -> mood -> serial -> LED blink
description: Via chuff-mvp-demo. Superseded for novelty scoring by ch-32's real pipeline; kept as the simplest possible bench-test path.

title: UNO Q + Modulino kit on order
description: Everything in phase 3 below needs the real hardware to verify.

title: Physical two-unit experiment: second real unit, 2-3m apart, 48h+
description: Blocked on a second ESP32-S3 board (or the UNO Q) being available. ch-23a is a stand-in, not a substitute - proves the mechanism is sufficient in a toy acoustic world, not that it behaves the same against a real room/speakers/mics.

title: Two-unit convergence in software (two_unit_demo.py)
description: Two independent simulated units, one acoustic channel, no shared data structure. Reproduces the social-gating prediction: contingent acknowledgement converges within ~5 rounds and stays stable; passive exposure alone gives 0% ack rate and call choice never settles. See shared/research_backlog.md Theme 1.3/3.2.
